preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 3 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be uppercase alphabets.
The string s must contain at least three different characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the longest string with characters in descending order of ASCII code and in arithmetic progression.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(stdout[i]) >= ord(stdout[i+1]) for i in range(len(stdout)-1))
postconditions.description: The characters in the output string must be in descending order of their ASCII values.
The output string must have a length of at least 3.
